description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
